_README: Copy this file to automation/config.json (which is gitignored) and fill in your keys. NEVER commit real keys. Env vars override these: LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, BRAVE_API_KEY.

local.note: LM Studio (OpenAI-compatible). Free. Load a model in LM Studio first. Used first to save money.

brave.note: Brave Search API — used server-side only for research, never in the browser.
